license: CC-BY (Creative Commons Attribution per IEEE DataPort page)

source_notes: Abtahi et al. ACM MMSys 2014. Set 1: 322 videos (mirror, 3-4 per subject); set 2: 29 videos (dash). Confirm access route and license with authors before any integration. Physiological modality - complementary to visual ground truth (see compatibility matrix).

redistribution_permission: NO (RESTRICTED - cannot be distributed to second parties)
source_notes: Weng et al. ACCV Workshop on Driver Drowsiness Detection from Video 2016. 36 subjects; 5 scenarios (BareFace/Glasses/Sunglasses/Night_BareFace/Night_Glasses); day 30 fps / night 15 fps. Access requires signed Dataset License Agreement (department head/lab director signature) + email request. Frame labels use long-term memory (context of previous seconds) - known label corruption near state transitions (see compatibility matrix).
